name: Reckon
description: Verify email addresses directly from Claude. Check deliverability, catch typos and fake signups, and flag risky addresses like disposables—all in real-time. Make email hygiene a native part of your workflow, whether you're processing signups, cleaning lists, or validating leads before they hit your CRM.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Reckon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Reckon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.reckonapp.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Reckon MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reckon provides these MCP tools: check_credits and verify_email.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Reckon?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Reckon in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Reckon requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Reckon is developed by Reckon LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
